rows.ja: 大手プラットフォームとの提携

relations.text: 年次報告が、Salesforceを販売拡大に役立つ提携先として挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report lists Salesforce among partners that help sell into more accounts

source.label: Docusign 10-K
source.quote: We have partnerships with some of the world’s foremost technology providers including Salesforce, Microsoft, SAP, Google, ServiceNow, and Workday—that help us sell into a far greater number of accounts than we could do alone.

relations.text: Microsoft FoundryやAzure Kubernetes Serviceなどを組み合わせ、契約書のAI分析基盤を構築している
relations.text_en: Docusign built its agreement intelligence platform by combining Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI in Foundry Models, Azure Kubernetes Service and Azure database services

source.label: DOCU / Microsoft — primary relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.label_en: DOCU / Microsoft — primary relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.quote: “By combining Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI in Foundry Models, Azure Kubernetes Service, and Azure database services, we built a platform that lets us continuously improve model performance while scaling agreement intelligence efficiently and reliably across our customer base,” says Marnadi.

relations.text: 年次報告が、SAPとは製品連携と共同販売の関係があると述べている
relations.text_en: The annual report says Docusign has product integrations and co-selling relationships with SAP

source.label: Docusign 10-K
source.quote: Within our GTM strategy evolution, we are investing in deeper partner engagement across strategic technology partners like Microsoft, SAP, and Salesforce with whom we have both product integrations and co-selling relationships.

relations.text: DocusignはSAPなどの主要アプリケーションと連携している
relations.text_en: Docusign integrates with core applications including SAP

source.label: Docusign 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Docusign integrates with core applications like Coupa, Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce, SAP, and Slack – so agreement workflows happen seamlessly across systems teams use every day, from triggering actions to surfacing completed agreements and the insights they contain.

relations.text: DocusignはMCPサーバーを通じてGeminiと接続している
relations.text_en: Docusign connects with Gemini through its open platform and MCP server

source.label: Docusign 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Through our open platform and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, Docusign connects with leading frontier models like Anthropic Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI ChatGPT – so teams can create, review, and manage agreements using natural language within the tools they already use.

relations.text: DocusignのSCIM機能は、Oktaなどとの連携でユーザーを自動管理できる
relations.text_en: SCIM for Docusign lets customers automatically provision and manage users through integrations with Okta

source.label: Docusign 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Addressing the enterprise need for efficient, secure, and scalable user management, SCIM for Docusign now allows customers to automatically provision and centrally manage users through integrations with Okta and Microsoft Entra.

relations.text: Docusignは、Thomson ReutersのCoCounselを含むリーガルAI基盤と提携している
relations.text_en: Docusign is partnering with legal AI platforms including CoCounsel by Thomson Reuters

source.label: Docusign 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Docusign is also partnering with leading legal AI platforms, including Harvey, Legora, and CoCounsel by Thomson Reuters.

relations.text: IAM for SalesはHubSpotなどのCRMに契約業務を取り込む
relations.text_en: IAM for Sales brings the agreement lifecycle into CRMs like HubSpot

source.label: Docusign 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: IAM for Sales brings the full agreement lifecycle directly into CRMs like HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Salesforce.

relations.text: nCinoが、自社基盤に統合された技術パートナーとしてDocusignを挙げている
relations.text_en: nCino names Docusign among technology partners integrated within its platform

source.label: nCino 10-K
source.quote: Utilizing the open architecture of the nCino Platform, an increasing number of technology partners, including Anthropic, AWS, Databricks, Salesforce, Rich Data Co, Alloy, Plaid, and Docusign, are integrated within our Platform.

relations.text: 年次報告が、Deutsche Telekomを業種・地域別の専門性を持つ提携先として挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report lists Deutsche Telekom among global solution provider partners with vertical and regional expertise

source.label: Docusign 10-K
source.quote: We also have partnerships with global solution providers such as Deutsche Telekom and others that have expertise in specific vertical and regional markets, enabling us to add further value directly to those markets.

relations.text: Bank of America, N.A.などとのクレジット契約(2021年1月11日付)が年次報告に挙げられている

source.label: Docusign 10-K
source.quote: 4.2 Credit Agreement, dated as of January 11, 2021, by and among the Registrant, Bank of America, N.A., BofA Securities, Inc. and Silicon Valley Bank, and the lenders thereunder.

relations.text: 同クレジット契約の第1次修正(2023年5月26日付)がある
